title: The Roots Arguing Softly

features.name: the argument chamber
features.desc-on-touch: You descend into a hollow where roots have learned to speak in separate directions. Their voices do not agree, yet the earth holds them all.

features.name: the northern root
features.desc-on-touch: You trace this root climbing toward the sky-dark, insisting that growth means ascent. Its bark is pale and reaching, one argument made of wood.

features.name: the southern root
features.desc-on-touch: You follow this root spreading laterally, arguing that depth and width are the same thing. It splits into finer and finer threads, the earth's counterargument.

features.name: where agreement grows anyway
features.desc-on-touch: You find where both roots have braided themselves around a stone. The stone holds them both. This is how the chamber stands.

features.name: the listening soil
features.desc-on-touch: You rest your hand in soil that has learned which voices go together and which ones teach each other better apart. It is patient earth.

inscription: roots that learned to disagree taught the earth that breaking and holding are not opposites

file.name: RootDissent_Acoustic_Study_Depth_245m.wav
file.note: field recording of root-pressure cavities at two meters depth: two frequencies diverging, never resolving, yet supporting the same stone for seven years

reverie.title: REVERIE — under the spreading eucalyptus, a question dividin
narr: You sit with her under the old tree, roots visible in the bank.
She says something about the archive—wrong about its purpose.
You disagree. The roots around you split the soil: north, south, down.
Neither of you moves. The tree holds both opinions in its frame.
This, you learn, is what support feels like when thought goes separate way

exits.label: back to the ascending roots where young and old begin their spiral
deeper still where the roots forget they ever met above
upward to the canopy where agreement is still only a word
